tasks.title: Port deterministic date restoration
tasks.context: Port the pure regex month rehydration helpers from upstream before the structured parser depends on them. This task is file-disjoint from text extraction, JSON helpers, and result models, so it can run in parallel after scaffolding.
acceptance_criteria: `restore_dates_from_markdown` and the internal date extraction helper match upstream behavior for work experience, education, personal projects, and custom item-list sections.

Characterization tests cover upstream examples: full range, present/current range, single date, year-only ignored, already-monthful fields preserved, non-dict entries skipped, and missing sections tolerated.
Implementation is pure Python regex logic with no LLM, no MarkItDown, no `app.*` imports, and no network.

tasks.title: Port MarkItDown text extraction
tasks.context: Add deterministic extraction from bytes plus filename. This is the always-available no-LLM half of the parser and must stay independent of the structured parsing provider path.
acceptance_criteria: `parse_document` or equivalent accepts `(content: bytes, filename: str)` and returns Markdown text for PDF/DOCX inputs via MarkItDown.
A first-class `extract_resume_text` no-LLM entrypoint returns extracted text plus structured warnings/provenance-compatible metadata for Markdown/plain text and MarkItDown-backed files.
Plain text and Markdown inputs do not require MarkItDown conversion when a simple decode is sufficient, and invalid or empty inputs produce warnings rather than provider calls.
Tests cover Markdown/plain text and at least one MarkItDown conversion fixture or generated fixture; all tests run without network.
Source file carries the modified-source marker for `apps/backend/app/services/parser.py` at SHA `116f9cc3b00e1ac91734a6c2679bf41ea64a0edc`.

tasks.title: Define parser result models
tasks.context: Create the package-local result contracts for extracted text, structured parse output, confidence, warnings, and provenance. This is new resume-kit surface area and should compose existing core and schemas types rather than duplicating them.
acceptance_criteria: Result models represent extracted Markdown text, optional `ResumeDocument`, confidence in `[0.0, 1.0]`, warnings, and provenance for deterministic and LLM-produced parts.
Models reuse `resume_kit_core.errors.CoreWarning` and `resume_kit_core.response.ProvenanceRef` where practical, and `resume_kit_schemas.ResumeDocument` for structured resumes.
No upstream attribution marker is used for wholly new result models, but docstrings make the deterministic-vs-LLM provenance methods clear.
Tests cover defaults, confidence bounds, no-LLM unavailable signaling, and serialization via Pydantic v2.
tasks.implementation_notes:
Recommended Agent: sonnet + medium
Implement new models in `results.py`; likely shapes: `ParseMethod` enum (`deterministic`, `llm`), `TextExtractionResult`, `StructuredParseResult` or unified `ParseResult`. Prefer Pydantic v2 `BaseModel`/`Field`, strict types, and frozen value objects only where useful. Keep warnings as `CoreWarning` to satisfy the initiative's core taxonomy requirement; use `ProvenanceRef` for source lineage metadata such as filename, method, and upstream-derived parser identifiers.

tasks.title: Adapt structured resume parsing behind provider protocol
tasks.context: Implement the LLM-only structured parse path as a thin adapter over `StructuredCompletionProvider`, composing deterministic text extraction, prompt constants, date restoration, schema validation, result models, warnings, confidence, and public exports.
acceptance_criteria: `parse_resume_structured(data, filename, provider)` extracts text, calls only the injected `StructuredCompletionProvider`, restores month-inclusive dates, validates into `ResumeDocument`, and returns a parse result with confidence, warnings, and provenance.
A text-only/no-provider path returns extracted text and a structured warning that structured parsing is unavailable rather than raising.

Provider failures, malformed provider output, empty extracted text, and Pydantic validation failures map to warnings/reduced confidence or structured errors according to existing core taxonomy; tests assert no crashes for expected non-fatal cases.
Provider-boundary tests use `resume_kit_core.testing.FakeStructuredCompletionProvider` only and perform no network calls.
Public `resume_kit_document_parser.__init__` exports the text extraction entrypoint, structured parse entrypoint, and result models.
Adapted source carries the modified-source marker for `apps/backend/app/services/parser.py` at SHA `116f9cc3b00e1ac91734a6c2679bf41ea64a0edc`.
tasks.implementation_notes:
Recommended Agent: opus + medium
Adapt upstream `upstream/apps/backend/app/services/parser.py:144-179` without carrying over `app.llm`, `app.prompts`, `app.schemas`, `get_llm_config`, `get_model_name`, or `get_safe_max_tokens`. Build a `StructuredCompletionRequest` from `resume_kit_core.providers` with system message `You are a JSON extraction engine. Output only valid JSON, no explanations.` and prompt text from `PARSE_RESUME_PROMPT.format(schema=RESUME_SCHEMA_EXAMPLE, resume_text=markdown_text)`. Provider returns `dict[str, Any]`; then call `restore_dates_from_markdown`, validate with `resume_kit_schemas.ResumeDocument.model_validate`, and store `model_dump()` only if the result model wants a raw payload. Import and compose `text_extraction.py`, `dates.py`, `prompts.py`, and `results.py`; do not edit those modules here unless a small integration fix is unavoidable.
